name: Multiple Layered Screens Display
aliases: Light Field and Lumigraph Methods (in context of displays)
definition: A display technique that stacks multiple 2D displays (LCDs, OLEDs, or optical stops) to create a depth illusion via parallax or by halting projected light at specific depth layers.
summary: Multiple Layered Screens Display stacks static 2D panels to create volumetric depth, differing from other methods by using discrete physical planes instead of moving surfaces or optical adjustments.
